content: Python unittest.mock.AsyncMock patches async functions. Pattern: with patch('module.async_func', new_callable=AsyncMock) as mock: mock.return_value = 'result'. For the existing test pattern in this project (asyncio.run() without pytest-asyncio): wrap test in async def run(): ... and call asyncio.run(run()). For testing compliance_narrative_service: patch('compliance_narrative_service.ai_service') and set ai_service.generate_text = AsyncMock(return_value='test text'). All 8 tests must use asyncio.run() wrapper — consistent with test_agentic_ai.py and test_scheduled_reports.py patterns.
